rationale: Unknown selectors now raise SecurityError before config/defaults/client/credential access, rather than selecting Moonshot. Direct configuration and mutated clients also revalidate backend/endpoint. Import no longer reads .env or configures global logging; only the selected provider resolves lazy URL/key/model values after validation, while local roles read no remote keys. Existing .api_key consumer compatibility is covered. Six original confined regressions failed; patched selector/order/local/known-route cases pass with zero attempts on rejection.
guards: Known default moonshot remains remote; only unknown selectors lose the implicit remote fallback.
Selected official provider hosts require HTTPS/443. Explicit loopback gateway overrides retain the old HTTP/HTTPS exception and may carry the selected remote Bearer.
Local roles only select canonical loopback hosts and never attach Authorization or resolve remote keys.
URL/key/model/timeout are fixed per call and retry; next call revalidates configuration. This is not a cross-thread configuration transaction or immutable caller-message snapshot.
The HTTPX transport uses follow_redirects=False and trust_env=False. Operator proxy/CA environment is no longer an implicit routing input.
API keys are lazy/hidden from repr; own errors do not echo URL, body, prompt or exception text. Arbitrary caller/third-party logging is outside this guarantee.
HTTPX MockTransport/recorders only, synthetic HOME/env and dotenv blocked before import; sockets/DNS prohibited. No provider, real credential, native/hardware auth or ATTESTED.
No real TLS handshake, DNS routing, service availability or OS network containment is certified.

source_checks.observation: Exact enum/known-string selection; invalid values never become a remote default.
Validates the requested backend before constructing configuration or client.
Inert defaults validate only the selected endpoint before any credential resolution.
Resolves only selected credentials; local roles return no key.

runtime_scope: Actual HTTPX parser/client with MockTransport and controlled async retry barriers; synthetic env and TCP/DNS forbidden.

rationale: Endpoint policy validates raw syntax with urllib/HTTPX and exact role/host, rejecting official provider HTTP, non-443 external ports, userinfo, query/fragment, controls/backslash and ambiguous or unsupported hosts before credentials/headers/client creation. Explicit configs and the final HTTP helper share the guard. Per-call immutable target prevents retry-time config mutation from sending an old provider key to a new endpoint; redirects and ambient proxy routing are disabled. HTTP/exception diagnostics no longer echo response bodies or secret-bearing text. The original allowlist loopback gateway exception is retained and explicitly bounded; this is not a claim that every remote-role override uses HTTPS.
